enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Coruscating 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 3d6 Light damage on each hit.
Disintegrate 2: Strikes with this weapon have a small chance to call forth a strike of entropic force, dealing 2d20+27 untyped damage.

Paralyzing 45: Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 45 Will save or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
